links.to_node: prevent my colleague from designing the new dam.
The new dam is not designed or constructed
Local ecosystems along the river remain undisturbed
Wildlife in the river and surrounding areas are not killed due to dam construction
The region does not benefit from the more efficient hydroelectric power source
Energy costs in the region do not decrease as they would have with the dam
My colleague is unable to proceed with the dam project.
